Messages.Author: Karo
Messages.Body:
If youre going for that crypt, but overall better choice for a deck based on horseshoes is Kamiri
Kamiri wa Itherero Advanced
Clan: Akunanse (group 4)
Capacity: 10
Disciplines: ABO ANI FOR OBF pot qui
Laibon: Kamiri can inflict 2 unpreventable damage on a minion as a  action.
[MERGED] Once each action, Kamiri may burn 1 blood to give an acting Laibon +1 stealth.

Rarity: EK:U

Get her superior POT and do 4 unpreventable each turn with freak drives. Kiss of Ra etc. A big plus is that she has Horseshoes in her text so it opens a lot of new tactics.
